# E01 — spec

The question: does a control sequence rendered from the staged scene hold the same
character across a turn, and is the depth pass normalized the same way as the render.

## Hypotheses and predictions

H1 — the control sequence holds the character across the full turn. Prediction: the
figure reads as one character at every view the sheet carries, judged at full size.

H2 — the depth pass and the render disagree on normalization. Prediction: the depth
pass is off by a constant scale, visible as a flat offset in the manifest values.

## Out of scope

Nothing is generated here and no credit is spent. The spec exists so this fixture has
a document that carries prose sections and no rulings at all.
